task.description: Retrieve at most five Crossref Works metadata rows for the same public artificial-intelligence-and-healthcare topic used in the OpenAlex source comparison.

execution.permission: One explicit public read-only GET to api.crossref.org/v1/works; no email, API key, billing credential, file write, redirect, or retry.

tool_receipt.claim_ceiling: An HTTP-200 provider response was received, but the first parser version rejected it and returned no metadata.

repair_note: A later bounded observation of the same query exposed a provider result with issued.date-parts=[[null]]. The parser now treats a null year as unreported. The final successful run has the same response SHA-256 as this failed run, so the failure is preserved and the same response bytes are now parsed without inventing a year.
